select COALESCE(SUM(medication_revenue), 0) as total_medication, COALESCE(SUM(appointment_revenue), 0) as total_appointment, COALESCE(SUM(lab_revenue), 0) as total_lab, COALESCE(SUM(admission_revenue), 0) as total_admission, COALESCE(SUM(bed_fee_revenue), 0) as total_bed_fee from "revenue_summaries" where "transaction_date" between '2025-11-01 00:00:00' and '2025-11-30 23:59:59' and "revenue_summaries"."tenant_id" = '2ebc45a9-cabc-429e-970b-a88d333353a2' limit 1

select count(*) as aggregate from (select "patient_id", SUM(medication_revenue) as medications, SUM(appointment_revenue) as appointments, SUM(lab_revenue) as labs, SUM(admission_revenue) as admissions, SUM(bed_fee_revenue) as bed_fees, (SUM(medication_revenue) + SUM(appointment_revenue) + SUM(lab_revenue) + SUM(admission_revenue) + SUM(bed_fee_revenue)) as total from "revenue_summaries" where "transaction_date" between '2025-12-01 00:00:00' and '2025-12-31 23:59:59' and "revenue_summaries"."tenant_id" = '2ebc45a9-cabc-429e-970b-a88d333353a2' group by "patient_id") as "aggregate_table"
